Inside the app

Everything the book teaches, made to practise.

Four study tools built around how the 309A exam is written and scored. Use them in any order, and your progress carries across all of them.

500 Q

Practice with reasons

Every question comes with a worked explanation, so you learn why the right answer is right and why the traps are wrong.

5 exams

Timed mock exams

Five full 100-question exams, weighted by Major Work Activity and timed like the real thing, with a pace meter.

Daily

A review deck that remembers

Missed questions come back on a spaced schedule (1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days) until they stick for good.

Countdown

A plan to your exam date

Set your exam date and the app sets a daily target, tracks your streak and tells you what to study next.

How it works

Three steps from book to pass.

Sign in with the book

Enter your name and the access word printed on the cover. Your questions unlock right on your device.

Practise and review daily

Work through short sets, read the explanations, and clear the review deck each day to keep your streak going.

Sit the mock exams

When your breakers are holding, take full timed mocks until you're scoring well above 70%, consistently.

What the exam covers

100 questions, weighted by Major Work Activity (MWA)
